summary: # LetzAI Polling Pattern Guide LetzAI uses asynchronous generation for all image and video operations. This guide explains how to properly implement polling to check job status and retrieve results. ## Why Polling? AI image and video generation takes time (seconds to minutes). Instead of keeping connections open, LetzAI uses an async pattern: 1. **Submit Job** → Receive job ID immediately 2. **Poll Status** → Check periodically until complete 3. **Get Result** → Fetch URLs when ready ## Status Flow ``` ┌─────┐ ┌─────────────┐ ┌───────┐
